data.title: bn-fj34: delete MetaStore, FjallSnapshotBackend, and the fjall dependency
data.description:
Deletes the second storage engine. mess-index::meta + FjallSnapshotBackend + the fjall manifest dep are gone; cargo tree -i fjall matches nothing workspace-wide and Cargo.lock drops fjall + 16 transitive crates.

Public surfaces: EngineOptions::dedupe_capacity deleted (dead), EngineError::Meta renamed Registry, rebuild-index --meta removed, backup's meta/ collection + 'meta' CutFile role removed, store::meta_dir removed, metaread::read is now infallible (removing doctor's meta-store-locked/registry-unavailable and retention's snapshots-unavailable). inspect's registry.snapshots_available pinned true for JSON schema stability.

REVIEWER ATTENTION: one non-mechanical change. retention explain was silently vacuous against real app snapshots — decide_segment matches the sealed index's interned DENSE stream ids, but a pack snapshot's id is the interim FNV hash of its name. Only the legacy dense-keyed fixture made the test pass. retention::run now joins pack record stream NAME -> registryfold -> dense id, with a loud registry-unfoldable warning when the bijection is unavailable. Fail-closed, but it is a behavior change in a destructive-adjacent explainer and deserves scrutiny.

Also: pack-vs-fjall differential converted to pack-only self-consistency (same corpus, replay-derived expectations); doctor_lock_state/inspect_report_shape lock cases now hold the real D9 lock and assert the fold-version check RUNS under a live writer; engine_name_durability's meta-deleted test became a positive whole-tree layout assertion.

Evidence: mess-store+mess-index+mess-cli+social 530/530 (MESS_SNAPSHOT_LAW_ITERS=25); cargo check --workspace --all-targets clean; just fmt-check clean; clippy zero net-new vs trunk.
